title: Nonnegative uniform volume
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every set $A\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, the uniform volume $\mu(A)$ satisfies $0\le\mu(A)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite subset of the Boolean cube
replaced: For every $A\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, its uniform volume satisfies $\mu(A)=|A|/2^n\ge0$.
